598:t_5:73.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$サイアム$$...! I'll move you somewhere safe!」

598:t_5:74.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could you take care of $$オードリー$$, too?」

598:t_5:76.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...You were at the mansion when I received the $$ユニコーン$$ from my father, weren't you?」

598:t_5:77.en:
$$ガエル$$
「Yes. I was serving $$カーディアス$$ then.」

598:t_5:78.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$バナージ$$... Your father had a dream: to build a new world in a future where the Box had been opened.」

598:t_5:79.en:
$$バナージ$$
「My father's dream... So he entrusted it to me...」

598:t_5:80.en:
$$ガエル$$
「But you came this far of your own free will. You were not bound by any curse.」

598:t_5:81.en:
$$ガエル$$
「So go forward without hesitation. You... are your father's dream itself.」

598:t_5:84.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm off, $$オードリー$$. I... am part of $c.」

598:t_6:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is where it all began. It seems you can see it, too, after all.」

598:t_6:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then shall we travel together... to the end of time in this universe, $$バナージ$$!?」

598:t_6:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There is no light, and even time has stopped in this absolute void... This is the world that awaits at the end of existence... at the end of time...」

598:t_6:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this... a future of despair...?」

598:t_6:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Who can say...? But I certainly tasted despair.」

598:t_6:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Humanity would not change even when shown the light of the human heart... But that is not their own fault...」

598:t_6:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「In the end, humans cannot become gods, nor can they surpass God.」

598:t_6:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans have a god... The power to go beyond the present... an inner god called possibility...!」

598:t_6:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You can say that because you do not know the truth.」

598:t_6:20.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you learned the truth of the Box, you would be unable to bear its weight and sink into despair.」

598:t_6:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The truth of the Box... $$クロノ$$'s doctrine...」

598:t_6:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter how humans struggle, the outcome will not change...」

598:t_6:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Surely you understand. Hope and possibility are fleeting dreams at the entrance to this void... Illusions that offer not even comfort.」

598:t_6:24.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「They lead people astray and cause pointless conflict. Only those who know this truth are truly chosen.」

598:t_6:26.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We should not give excessive hopes to lives that merely exist and fade away.」

598:t_6:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$アムロ$$! Why are you here!?」

598:t_6:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「One day, humans will control even time... I believe that day will come, too.」

598:t_6:31.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean when $$ララァ$$ died...!」

598:t_6:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There is warmth inside you, too!」

598:t_6:33.en:
$$シン$$
「That's what it means to be alive!」

598:t_6:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「No matter how dark it gets, we will never lose sight of tomorrow.」

598:t_6:36.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Laugh if you think we're fools. But we believe.」

598:t_6:37.en:
$$刹那$$
「The future will come... No, we'll open the way with our own hands.」

598:t_6:38.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We don't have time to wallow in despair!」

598:t_6:39.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Time moves toward the future, if we only wish it to.」

598:t_6:40.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is the civilization of fire... What humans create themselves grants humanity new power...」

598:t_6:41.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The power to believe in hope together with someone else...」

598:t_6:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You must know that, too.」

598:t_6:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$シャア・アズナブル$$ within you fell into despair, crossed space-time in the $$新世時空震動$$, and entered you as his vessel.」

598:t_6:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「You were too pure, $$フロンタル$$. You worried earnestly about the world, rushed to find an answer, and tried to carry the world alone.」

598:t_6:48.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Forgive me. I should have been the one to understand you.」

598:t_6:49.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're apologizing now, $$シャア$$!?」

598:t_6:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But you will all learn someday, too! Warmth... warm light... No matter how much of it gathers, nothing...!」

598:t_6:52.en:
???
「This warmth will warm the universe, won't it?」

598:t_6:58.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

598:t_6:59.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ$$... you who are guided by the $$ガンダム$$... And $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

598:t_6:60.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You may be able to find a rainbow beyond the despair I could not overcome.」

598:t_6:62.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And beyond even that, find the future.」

598:t_6:63.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I entrust it... to you... Do what... you believe must be done...」

598:t_7:4.en:
$$サイアム$$
「...What sort of future will this bring...?」

598:t_7:6.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Perhaps nothing will change... Words are only words. Even laws can be interpreted however people find convenient.」

598:t_7:7.en:
$$サイアム$$
「With the $$新地球皇国$$ still here, it may prove to be a meaningless act of folly.」

598:t_7:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even so... Even so, $$バナージ$$ and $c will do what they believe must be done.」

598:t_7:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Just like the people who engraved their heartfelt goodwill on this monument the day humanity chose to live in the new world of space.」

598:t_7:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Just like you, who protected the Box to pass that goodwill on to the present.」

598:t_7:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That boy... has found a fine partner...」
